title: Time Particles : に, から, まで

blocks.content: Three particles handle time relationships. **に** pins an action to a specific point : at a clock time or calendar date. **から** marks a start point. **まで** marks an end point. から and まで are often paired.

lines: [Start] **から** [End] **まで** + [action]  ← from A until B
[Start] **から** + [action]                ← from / since A (no end given)

rows.japanese: 月曜日に病院へ行きます。
rows.english: I go to the hospital on Monday.

rows.japanese: 九時から五時まで働きます。
授業は十時から始まります。
去年から日本語を勉強しています。
rows.romaji: Kyonen kara nihongo wo benkyō shite imasu.
rows.english: I've been studying Japanese since last year.

blocks.content: に is **not** used with relative time words like 今日, 明日, 毎日, 来週. These words are already time-referencing and don't need に. Say 明日行きます : never 明日**に**行きます. Think of に as "at a specific clock or calendar point." If the word is relative, drop the に.
